primary.message: one piece of the reference `1st state`

secondary.message: declared here as a single ID containing whitespace

notes: ID references are whitespace-separated lists, so `1st state` is read as separate IDs; the root cause is the invalid ID declaration (SCXML003)
diagnostics.help: rename the declaration to a valid NCName and update this reference; the SCXML003 suggestion does both

diagnostics.message: identifier `1st state` is not an XML NCName
notes: SCXML IDs are XML IDs: they must start with a letter or `_` and contain only NCName characters (no spaces or colons), so references can be tokenized unambiguously. An `id` is `xsd:ID`, whose white space collapses (XML Schema 1.1 Part 2 §4.3.6), so leading and trailing white space is not part of it: `id=" s "` declares `s`
diagnostics.help: start with a letter or underscore and use only NCName characters; colons are not allowed
